Home / How It Works

A little practice.
A story that stays with you.

1. Choose your level

B1 uses clearer language, B2 adds detail, and C1 offers a more demanding version. You can switch levels from any listening part. Start with the first chapter: the story unfolds in order.

2. Explore the words and listen

Open the vocabulary if you need support. Press play and listen as often as you like. Change the playback speed if that helps. Audio starts only when you choose to play it.

3. Answer six questions

Choose one option for every question and select “Check my answers”. You will see your score, the correct options and an explanation. Select “Try again” for a fresh attempt; your last submitted result stays saved until you submit again.

4. Unlock the transcript

After submitting all six answers, read the transcript and listen again. The transcript remains available when you return to a part with a saved result.

5. Come back for the next part

Progress is saved in this browser when storage is available. It does not sync between devices. Clearing browser data or using private browsing can remove it. No account is required.
